f: How tall was the Prophet ﷺ?
b: Of medium height: neither very tall nor short. Anas رضي الله عنه described him as of middle stature.

f: How did Anas رضي الله عنه describe the Prophet's ﷺ hair?
b: Neither tightly curled nor completely straight, but slightly wavy.

f: How long was the Prophet's ﷺ hair?
b: It reached about his earlobes, and at times down to his shoulders.

f: How many white hairs did the Prophet ﷺ have when he passed away?
b: Very few: fewer than twenty white hairs in his head and beard.

f: What was the Prophet's ﷺ complexion?
b: Fair and radiant, not stark white and not dark.

f: How did al-Bara' رضي الله عنه describe the Prophet's ﷺ face?
b: When asked whether it was like a sword, he said no: it was like the moon.

f: Where was the seal of prophethood?
b: Between his shoulders, nearer the left shoulder blade.

f: What did the seal of prophethood look like?
b: A raised piece of flesh about the size of a pigeon's egg, like the button of a canopy.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ walk?
b: Briskly and firmly, leaning slightly forward, as if coming down a slope.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ turn to someone?
b: He turned his whole body towards them, not just his head.

f: Which garment did the Prophet ﷺ love most?
b: The qamis (long shirt).

f: Which colour of clothing did he encourage?
b: White: wear white, for it is purer and better, and shroud your dead in it.

f: What was the Prophet's ﷺ ring made of?
b: Silver.

f: What was engraved on the ring, and how?
b: 'Muhammad Rasul Allah' in three lines: Muhammad on one line, Rasul on one line, Allah on one line.

f: Why did the Prophet ﷺ have a ring made?
b: To seal his letters to kings, because he was told they would only accept a sealed letter.

f: What were the Prophet's ﷺ sandals like?
b: They had two straps.

f: What bread did the Prophet's ﷺ family usually eat?
b: Barley bread, and his family did not eat their fill of it two days in a row.

f: Which condiment did the Prophet ﷺ praise?
b: Vinegar: 'What an excellent condiment vinegar is.'

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about olive oil?
b: Eat olive oil and rub it on your bodies, for it comes from a blessed tree.

f: Which part of the meat did the Prophet ﷺ like?
b: The shoulder (foreleg).

f: Which vegetable did the Prophet ﷺ like, according to Anas رضي الله عنه?
b: Pumpkin (gourd). Anas رضي الله عنه saw him picking it out from the dish.

f: What sweet things did the Prophet ﷺ love?
b: Sweets and honey.

f: How many fingers did the Prophet ﷺ eat with?
b: Three fingers, and he would lick them after eating.

f: Did the Prophet ﷺ eat while reclining?
b: No. He said: 'As for me, I do not eat while reclining.'

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ drink?
b: In three breaths, breathing outside the vessel, saying it is more satisfying and wholesome.

f: Which drink did the Prophet ﷺ love most?
b: Something sweet and cool.

f: Did the Prophet ﷺ refuse perfume when it was offered?
b: No, he never refused perfume.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ speak?
b: Clearly and distinctly, so that anyone sitting with him could remember it; not rapidly.

f: Why did the Prophet ﷺ sometimes repeat a word three times?
b: So that it would be understood.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ usually laugh?
b: Mostly by smiling.

f: How did 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها describe the Prophet's ﷺ character?
b: His character was the Qur'an.

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ do at home, according to 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها?
b: He was like any man: he mended his clothes, milked his sheep and served himself.

f: How did Abu Sa'id رضي الله عنه describe the Prophet's ﷺ modesty?
b: He was more modest than a virgin in her seclusion.

f: How generous was the Prophet ﷺ?
b: He never said 'no' to anyone who asked him for something, and he was most generous in Ramadan.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ lie down to sleep?
b: On his right side, with his right hand under his cheek.

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ say when going to sleep?
b: 'O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.'

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ say when he woke up?
b: 'Praise be to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the return.'

f: Why did the Prophet ﷺ pray at night until his feet swelled?
b: When asked, he said: 'Should I not be a grateful servant?'

f: How many rak'ahs did the Prophet ﷺ pray at night, according to 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها?
b: He did not exceed eleven rak'ahs, in Ramadan or outside it.

f: Did the Prophet ﷺ pray the Duha prayer?
b: Yes: four rak'ahs, and sometimes more, as Allah willed.

f: Which days of the week did the Prophet ﷺ fast?
b: Mondays and Thursdays, as deeds are presented to Allah on them.

f: In which month, after Ramadan, did the Prophet ﷺ fast the most?
b: Sha'ban.

f: How did the Prophet ﷺ recite the Qur'an at night?
b: Slowly and clearly, letter by letter, pausing at the end of each ayah.

f: What happened when Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه recited to the Prophet ﷺ up to 'How will it be when We bring from every nation a witness...'?
b: The Prophet ﷺ said 'Enough', and his eyes were flowing with tears.

f: Name some of the Prophet's ﷺ names he mentioned himself.
b: Muhammad, Ahmad, al-Mahi (by whom disbelief is erased), al-Hashir (at whose feet people are gathered) and al-'Aqib (the last).

f: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when he passed away?
b: Sixty-three years old.

f: What was the Prophet's ﷺ bed made of?
b: Leather stuffed with palm fibre.

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ leave behind when he passed away?
b: No dinar or dirham, no slave and nothing else except his white mule, his weapons and a piece of land he gave in charity.

f: What did the Prophet ﷺ say about seeing him in a dream?
b: Whoever sees me in a dream has truly seen me, for Shaytan cannot take my form.
